propositions: Four test guards (_test_the_provenance_analysis_can_see_the_sites_it_judges, _test_no_run_request_inherits_the_raw_config_model, _test_every_unfollowable_site_is_registered_with_a_reason, _test_neither_registry_has_stale_entries) each independently invoke _run_request_sites(), causing the same immutable AST analysis of src/rebar to be computed four times per session, incurring ~32s per test.

Within a single _run_request_sites() call, _verdict's parameter-provenance branch re-walks the full tree and re-parses every file once per parameter-provenance site, while _functions() also parses the whole tree, causing 8,033+ redundant parse operations in a single scan.

The analysis is a deterministic pure function of committed src/rebar source code; no test mutates the tree, and the only autouse fixture patches llm_config._read_llm_file_table which the AST scan never consults, making it safe to cache across the session.

Session-scoped pytest fixture caching of _run_request_sites() output and per-path memoization of ast.parse results via functools.cache will reduce redundant invocations from 4 to 1 and ensure each file is parsed at most once per process.
